confidence_notes: Medium overall. Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors come from aggregated cost-of-living sites (Numbeo-derived figures in EUR and lek, converted at differing rates), so they are rough. Cocktail and wine are not directly sourced: they are inferred from the local beer price, and no direct cocktail or by-the-glass wine price was found. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates for July high season, not checked against live listings. The FX observation is stale: the latest RBA observation I could retrieve is 2026-03-20, not one near the 2026-10-16 generation date. A later unofficial figure was not used because it is not an RBA observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Price levels follow aggregated Tirana cost-of-living data for food and drink. Cocktail and wine use a beer-ratio assumption. Accommodation uses general knowledge of Balkan capital price levels for summer demand, not live booking data.
